## Purpose

Describe the user workflow and the change.

## Evidence

List checks actually run and their limits. Use synthetic examples.

## Review

- [ ] No credentials, captured user data, private paths or restricted material.
- [ ] Missing coverage and known zero remain distinct.
- [ ] Data interpretation, privacy and relevant documentation are accurate.
- [ ] Source contributions comply with the adopted license/origin policy, once adopted.
- [ ] UI copy and navigation are consistent with the free tracking workflow.
